☢️ NFL THURSDAY NIGHT NUKEEEE 10/15 ☢️

J.K. Dobbins Over 12.5 Rushing Attempts 📈

SEAN PAYTON TAKING BACK PLAY-CALLING DUTIES IMMEDIATELY BOOSTED DOBBINS’ WORKLOAD. In Payton’s first game calling plays again last week, Dobbins handled a SEASON-HIGH 18 carries, scored his first rushing TD and clearly operated as Denver’s early-down runner. He’s now over 12.5 carries in 2 of his last 3 games (67%), and gets a Seattle defense that has faced 24+ RB rushing attempts in 3 of 5 games this season (60%) and allow the LEAST PASSING YARDS PER GAME (150.8). 

Dobbins is over in 2/3 of his last 3 games (67%):
Week 3 vs LAR, 17 carries | 49 yards ✅
Week 4 @ SF, 11 carries | 40 yards ❌
Week 5 @ LAC, 18 carries | 68 yards | TD ✅

Last week was the biggest sign yet that Denver wants Dobbins handling the EARLY-DOWN WORK. He finished with 18 of Denver’s RB carries, while RJ Harvey continued operating primarily as the receiving/change-of-pace option. Through five weeks, Dobbins has handled a rush attempt on roughly 50% of his snaps compared to only 15% for Harvey, their roles are VERY different even when the overall snap counts look similar ‼️

Seattle has been strong defensively overall, but teams have still been willing to RUN THE BALL against them:

Week 1, NE RBs, 24 carries
Week 2, ARI RBs, 16 carries
Week 3, WAS RBs, 27 carries
Week 4, LAC RBs, 24 carries
Week 5, SF RBs, 17 carries

Opposing backfields are averaging 21.6 RB carries per game, and Seattle allowed the Chargers’ backs to rush 24 times for 109 yards just two games ago. Dobbins doesn’t need Denver to dominate on the ground, he simply needs to maintain the majority of the early-down rushing work 📈

The PLAY-CALLING CHANGE matters even more because Payton has historically been willing to stay patient with the run when games remain close. Denver was trailing the Chargers last week and STILL fed Dobbins 18 times, so his volume wasn’t dependent on protecting a huge lead. That’s encouraging with Seattle favored by only around a field goal ‼️

Seattle is also dealing with injuries in the middle of its defense. Starting LB Drake Thomas has missed practice with an ankle injury, Chazz Surratt has also been sidelined, and DT Leonard Williams has been limited. Those are important pieces against the run, and their statuses are worth watching heading into Thursday ‼️
